'''"FortyLions"''' is an American ''Quake Champions'' commentator. 

He grew up playing Counter Strike 1.6 and later Global Offensive. In 2018, his caster career began by doing the Quake Champions Worldwide Cup [https://www.plusforward.net/quake/post/64069/FortyLions-Den-Worldwide-Cup-1/ FortyLions’ Dens]. His first official gig was at [[QuakeCon|QuakeCon 2018 Community Cast]] for Day 1 covering the Open Qualifiers of Quake Champions.
